test_update_target_variables: test the update_target_variables function to copy or incrementally blend source variables into target variables using tau
test_periodic_target_update: test the periodic_target_update function to apply target variable updates only every N executions
test_incompatible_length_validation: test that update_target_variables raises ValueError when target and source variable lists have unequal lengths
test_incompatible_shape_validation: test that update_target_variables raises ValueError when corresponding target and source variables have mismatched shapes
test_tau_parameter_validation: test that update_target_variables raises TypeError for non-float tau and ValueError for tau outside the (0, 1] range
